title: UNZA Great East Road Campus
content: UNZA's main campus is located along Great East Road in Lusaka, Zambia. It hosts most of the university's schools, administrative offices, the main library, student hostels, and sporting facilities. Some specialized schools (such as Medicine and Veterinary Medicine) may operate from other campus locations. Always confirm specific building/office locations with campus signage or the relevant department when visiting.
source: General public information — verify current details with UNZA

title: Getting Around Campus
content: UNZA's main campus is generally walkable between most schools, hostels, and central facilities such as the library and administration block. New students are encouraged to attend orientation activities, which typically include a campus tour, to become familiar with key locations such as their school/department, the registry, the library, and the health clinic.
source: General information — verify with Orientation/Student Affairs

title: Administration and Registry Offices
content: The Registry handles core administrative student matters such as registration records, transcripts, and official documentation. The Bursary/Finance office handles fee payments. These offices are usually centrally located on the main campus administration block. Exact office locations and opening hours should be confirmed on arrival or via official UNZA contact channels.
source: General information — verify with UNZA Registry
